### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A27, A36, A37, A42, A43, and A44 each appeared in all 200 traces; in the later window they appear in about 45–55% of traces (A27 45.5%, the others about 55%). [OCC002–OCC007]
- A10 participation dropped from 32% to 13%. [OCC001]
- A25's outgoing transitions changed from going to A36/A37/A42/A43/A44 (each 17–24%) to going to A28 in about 98.5% of cases. [DIR003]
- A26's outgoing transitions changed from A27 (97.5%) to a mix: A27 44.5%, A37 17%, A43 12%, A44 9.5%, A36 7%, A42 9%. [DIR004]
- In the earlier window, A26 always came after A36/A37/A42/A43/A44 (B_before_A ~0.98); in the later window, when both occur, A26 comes before them (A_before_B ~0.545). [REL026–REL030]
- The mean position of A26, A28, and A31 moved earlier (by about 0.09, 0.10, and 0.03 of the trace length), while A36, A37, A42, A43, and A44 moved later (by about 0.16–0.18). [POS004, POS006, POS007, POS008–POS012]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the process changed from a single sequence in which A25, A26, A27, A28, A31, A36, A37, A42, A43, and A44 were always executed together, to a process in which A27, A36, A37, A42, A43, and A44 are now executed in only about half of the cases, and when they are executed, A26 now precedes them instead of following them. A25 now leads to A28 instead of to that group. This is supported by the drop in participation of those activities, the routing change from A25 to A28, the branching of A26, the reversal of order between A26 and the group, and the corresponding position shifts. The evidence cannot rule out that the change reflects a different mix of process variants, but the consistency across indicators makes a real change likely.

Other differences: A10 participation decreased from 32% to 13%. [OCC001] A15 and A16 positions shifted slightly later. [POS001, POS002]
